Study method details: Bilirubin ditaurate disodium (conjugated, 14.4 mg in 0.75 mL DMSO) or unconjugated bilirubin (10.0 mg in 0.75 mL DMSO) spiked 0.25 mL into 4.75 mL plasma; a DMSO-only fraction gave the dilution-matched baseline; the two fractions recombined 25:75, 50:50, 75:25 to span the ACL TOP 750 preanalytical module range; % bias = (Rx-R0)/R0 x 100; Cuzick trend test
Additional sources of bias: spiked bilirubin, not native icteric plasma; solvent choice (DMSO vs aqueous) shown in the same PDF to change the result; the PT/APTT prolongation at the highest bilirubin was driven by the lyophilised ABN Control and could not be replicated in LAC+ or heparin patient pools, so the pooled means in Table 1 mix commutable and non-commutable materials; small n (6-9)
Notes: Tube 1 (I index 1 +/- 1 mg/dL) is the dilution-matched DMSO baseline. Table 1 prints only the baseline clotting time and the % relative difference; the interfered clotting time is not printed, so the calculated change columns are the missing literal. Manufacturer's recommended icterus threshold for PT-IL is 30 mg/dL; the laboratory adopted 45 mg/dL (Table 2). The PT/APTT prolongation at high bilirubin was seen only with the lyophilised ABN Control and was NOT reproduced in the LAC+ or heparin patient plasma pools (p8 Discussion), so the tabulated mean bias overstates the effect in real plasma.

Additional sources of bias: bilirubin was never measured - icterus was assigned by visual inspection only, so no concentration-response can be established; MAJOR DATA-INTEGRITY FLAG: the PT, aPTT and fibrinogen values reported in this paper's Tables 2, 3 and 4 are numerically identical to values printed in another project PDF (ijlh.12498, Woolley 2016) - icterus 13.62/13.54 and 29.72/30.38 and 4.34/4.23 match Woolley Table 4 (B0 and B20), haemolysis 16.60/16.61, 32.5/31.5 and 5.22/5.38 match Woolley Tables 1-2, and lipaemia 16.95/16.49 and 28.87/28.75 match Woolley Table 5 (L0 and L500), and the lipaemia fibrinogen pair 4.71/4.34 matches Woolley Table 5 STA-Liquid Fib L0/L500; the haemolysis PT pair 16.60/16.61 is Woolley's 16.61/16.60 with the two members REVERSED; and the quoted +/- values (e.g. 1.03, 2.87) are Woolley's SD-of-difference column, not sample standard deviations
Notes: Treat this row as NOT independent evidence. The icteric PT pair 13.62 vs 13.54 s reproduces exactly the B0 and B20 pool means from Woolley 2016 (ijlh.12498, Table 4, STA-Neoplastine CI Plus), a study performed on a different analyser (Stago STA-Compact-Max) with spiked bilirubin, whereas this paper describes visually icteric patient samples on a Sysmex CA-50. Woolley prints no P value at all for icterus vs PT (only the narrative 'Icterus had no statistically significant impact on PT'), so the P = 0.837 printed here has no counterpart in Woolley and its origin cannot be established from the PDFs. The direction and significance columns are filled from the printed numbers as the skill requires, but the underlying data cannot be treated as an independent replication.
